source: OurAirports airports.csv and runways.csv (https://ourairports.com/data/) – public domain
limitations: Potential diversion airports and modelled coverage only; not an operator’s authorisation. Runway evidence cannot establish operational suitability: RFFS, hours, weather, NOTAMs, approach aids, fuel, pavement strength and permission (including military access) are unknown. Lighting is recorded, not required.
